forum.title: STM32CubeIDE Build Button grayed out
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Ecapone

It looks like the project was imported using the wrong method. For a project generated by STM32CubeMX, the recommended way in STM32CubeIDE 2.2.0 is to use File → Import → Import STM32 Project → STM32CubeMX/STM32CubeIDE Project

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/4d71f151-f085-44ab-814d-46025b17e959.png)

Also , I recommend trying the import again in a **new workspace**

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text: I am trying the NUCLEO545RE-Q. I created a project, imported it to STM32CubeIDE 2.2.0. The build button is grayed out. I found several videos for version 2.0.0 where is easy and straight forward. With this version is not and I couldn’t find any help. What am I doing wrong?
forum.author: Ecapone
